meta.title: RepoChan — REPOCHAN OS · Rendering repos into mascots
meta.description: REPOCHAN OS: a glitching computer that renders your git repo into a mascot. Scan, analyze, persona, paint, deploy — every window on this page runs real dogfood orders.
